set.body:
At b737b14f, corpus/intake/CorpusReader.scala:164-172 retains all per-row refusals, flattens them, then takes RefusalCap. Output and total counts are correct, but collection memory is not bounded by100. Clarify the documented bound or accumulate total refusals while retaining only the first100 diagnostics. If implementation changes, preserve error order, exact totals and all existing refusal distinctions with a many-error synthetic court. No measured memory exhaustion or production impact claimed.

Independent review: docs/refactor/evidence/intake-cold-review-closeout-20260923/README.md; replacement review ticket bd-01M2WTPDBB4MQBXEJ181Q85ZG2. These are separate findings, not a reconstruction of the missing historical A3.
set.title: CorpusReader refusal cap must accurately describe or bound diagnostic collection
